title: Store Themes & Customization
description: Learn how to choose and customize store themes to match your brand and industry.
content:
Store Themes & Customization

Tijraa offers 10+ professionally designed themes tailored for different industries. This guide will help you choose and customize the perfect theme for your store.

Available Themes

Tijraa includes the following themes:

  • Home & Accessories (Default) - Home decor and accessories
  • Fashion & Apparel - Clothing, shoes, fashion items
  • Electronics & Technology - Gadgets and tech products
  • Beauty & Cosmetics - Skincare and makeup products
  • Jewelry & Accessories - Fine jewelry and accessories
  • Watches & Timepieces - Luxury and casual watches
  • Furniture & Interior - Home furniture and decor
  • Cars & Automotive - Vehicle parts and accessories
  • Baby & Kids - Children's products and toys
  • Perfume & Fragrances - Fragrance products

Choosing a Theme

To change your store theme:

  1. Go to Stores → Select your store
  2. Navigate to Settings
  3. Find the Theme section
  4. Click on a theme to preview it
  5. Click Apply to activate

Theme Features

All themes include:

  • Fully responsive design (mobile-friendly)
  • Fast loading performance
  • SEO-optimized structure
  • Customizable colors and branding
  • Theme-specific layouts

Customizing Colors

Each theme allows color customization:

  1. In store settings, find Theme Colors
  2. Select primary color (main brand color)
  3. Select secondary color (accent color)
  4. Select accent color (highlights)
  5. Preview changes in real-time
  6. Save when satisfied

Logo & Branding

Customize your store's branding:

  • Logo: Upload your store logo
  • Favicon: Browser tab icon (recommended: 32x32px)
  • Brand Colors: Match your brand identity

Homepage Sections

Customize homepage sections:

  • Hero/Banner section
  • Featured categories
  • Featured products
  • Trending products
  • Brand logos
  • Blog posts
  • Newsletter signup

Custom CSS

For advanced customization:

  • Add custom CSS code
  • Override theme styles
  • Create unique designs

Note: Custom CSS requires basic CSS knowledge.

Preview Before Publishing

Always preview your changes:

  1. Make customizations
  2. Click Preview button
  3. Review on different screen sizes
  4. Save when ready

Mobile Responsiveness

All themes are mobile-responsive. Test your store on:

  • Desktop computers
  • Tablets
  • Mobile phones

Switching Themes

You can switch themes anytime:

  • Your products and content remain
  • Only the design changes
  • Some customizations may need adjustment

Next Steps

After customizing your theme:

  • Manage store content
  • Add products
meta_description: Guide to choosing and customizing store themes in Tijraa, including color customization, branding, and responsive design.
